body_html:
The TL High Back Multi-Tilter pairs a breathable digital mesh back with a fully adjustable multi-tilt mechanism, giving every sitter true all-day support without the bulk of a traditional executive chair. Its contoured high back and side-activated seat depth adjustment make it an easy fit across private offices, open workstations, and shared institutional spaces. Designed and built in Canada by Global Furniture Group, it is engineered for the heavy daily use that schools, healthcare sites, and municipal offices demand.

Features

  • Infinite-position tilt lock with tilt tension adjustment
  • Independent back and seat angle adjustment
  • Side-activated sliding seat depth adjustment
  • Height-adjustable lumbar support
  • Pneumatic seat height adjustment (17.5"–21.25")
  • Height-adjustable 4D arms with sliding and rotating arm caps
  • Breathable digital mesh back in six colours; black frame
  • Five-prong fiberglass-reinforced nylon base with dual-wheel carpet casters (hard-surface casters optional)
  • Three mechanisms available: multi-tilter, weight-sensing synchro-tilter, and height-adjustable task stool
  • Rated to a 300 lb weight capacity

Specifications

Overall dimensions 25.75"W x 23"D x 40.62"H with a 17.5"–21.25" seat-height range. GREENGUARD certified and ANSI/BIFMA tested, backed by a 5-year warranty, with 15 years on the metal frame. Proudly designed and crafted in Canada.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned dealer (since 1964) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and finish selection, or call 1-800-835-9565.
